differences.openwhisper: The packaged Pi (Node) and OpenCode SDK (Bun) agents run as sidecar processes supervised from Python: payload checks with their own install messages, hello handshake, ping, restarts within a budget, and timeouts that read "RPC 'checkpoint' timed out after Ns" or "... stalled after Ns without agent progress"; a missing key reads "... meeting sidecar agent offline".
differences.openwhisper-cpp: pi, opencode and the legacy direct all build the in-process NativeAgentCore, which keeps the key resolution, pass budgets, stall clock, cancel and request-scoped authority; there is no process to supervise or install, a pass that fails fails only itself, and the messages read "Agent pass timed out after Ns", "Agent pass stalled after Ns without agent progress" and "No {provider} API key found; meeting agent offline".
differences.reason: The owner chose a native agent loop (amendment 1); everything that only supervised a sidecar process goes with the process.
